parameters.query:
SELECT
  cs_week_beg_dt::date::text AS week,
  SUM(sr_cnt::bigint)                                                                        AS volume,
  ROUND(SUM(rsltn_response_cnt::bigint)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(rsltn_cnt::bigint),0) * 100, 2) AS resolution_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(csat_sum::bigint)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(csat_response_cnt::bigint),0), 2)         AS csat,
  SUM(csat_response_cnt::bigint)                                                             AS csat_response_cnt
FROM public.cs_contacts
WHERE cs_week_beg_dt::date > (SELECT MAX(cs_week_beg_dt::date) FROM public.cs_contacts) - ($1::int * 7)
  AND ($2 = 'ALL' OR country      = $2)
  AND ($3 = 'ALL' OR l1_topic     = $3)
  AND ($4 = 'ALL' OR channel_type = $4)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
